data: 800 local HDF5 episodes, 190373 anchors; identical shuffled sampler seed42 for all cases
tactile: Trainable RAE-1in1-S, pool3x3, two sensors (18 tokens), depth_deform_radial, TPS28+bilinear; VLM fusion; no wrappers; 1D RoPE; causal mask
method: 2 warmup then mean of 10 steps; wall time before next(DataLoader) through synchronized AdamW completion; includes data reading/conversion via normal worker prefetch, H2D, forward, backward, clipping and update; excludes initial dataset/statistics/model setup and DDP communication
conversion_note: Worker-side conversion time excludes HDF5 reads. This CPU work overlaps GPU execution; it is not an additive fraction of total step time.
